name: Total Audio Promo (TAP) - Music PR & Radio Show Discovery
description: Orchestrates a 4-machine fleet to discover UK radio shows, extract producer contacts, sign up for station press portals, and write pitch reports to Obsidian Vault.

workflow.description: Hubert Master initializes Radio Discovery campaign for Total Audio Promo.
Research Agent scans UK Radio stations (BBC Radio 6, Absolute Radio) and extracts producer contacts.
Sign-Up Agent submits radio pitch forms and registers press accounts.
Obsidian Agent updates TAP Radio Play Tracking database & Obsidian Vault.
Hubert Master sends campaign summary report to Discord/Telegram channel.
